errors.evidence: The description lists 17 methods from the x-axis but omits the method "Inter-ECNC".

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图大约为 0.55，对应的类别为“MAM-SD”的 R 值
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the shortest bar. The shortest bar in the chart is the R value (orange) for 'Inter-EC', at a value of approximately 0.51. The description claims it is the R value for 'MAM-SD' at approximately 0.55, but the R value for 'MAM-SD' is actually around 0.58.
The description states the value of the longest bar is approximately 0.73, but the bar (P value for 'ECPE-KT') clearly reaches the 0.75 line on the y-axis.
The description misreads a character in one of the category labels on the x-axis. It writes "2阶段笛卡尔尔" (èr) when the label in the figure is "2阶段笛卡尔积" (jī).
